title: Born 1902 in Carrollton; moving to Palmer's Avenue
summary: He gives his birth date, early addresses near Audubon Park and Tulane, and recalls first seeing Roy Palmer on Palmer's Avenue.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: And where were you born and when?
I was born in 1902, up on Hillary Street. I don't remember the number, I heard my mother say, but that's up in Carrollton.
On Hillary?
Yeah.
I know exactly where that is. How far from the river?
I really don't know.
You don't remember that? No, I was small. When you were a baby there?

Yeah, I was a baby, you know. And I moved from up there, and in fact my parents did. They moved from there on to Palmer's Avenue. And so I must have been about, maybe around six years old, something like that. That's where I first saw Roy Palmer.
That was his street, huh?
Yeah, he lived right on Palmer's Avenue. Yeah.
What was the Cross Street? Do you remember? 100th Park?
I don't remember what the Cross Street is now, but let's see. I'll try to get as close as possible. That would be up there with the Fred. And then coming back from Fred would be what the...
Let's see, Robertson?
Yeah, it's Lou. Clara? It would be somewhere around Clara. Yeah, around Clara.
Clara Street, yeah. You weren't far from the back part of Tulane University where we are? Not too far away. Yeah. No. Because I guess they didn't have the...
Not too far away from Audubon Park either.
Yeah.
Not too far away, you know.
Yeah.
It wasn't a few blocks either, but it was in walking distance.
Yeah. What's your day of birth and month of birth?
January the 3rd, 1902.
Oh, like the 1902.
Yeah.
